deviations.what: 'Yes, it's with me' is disabled (locked colours, lock glyph in place of the chevron) with a reason line under it: 'Approving from your old phone isn't in this version of the app yet. Choose “No” below for now — …'
deviations.reason: Own-device linking (S0.2c/S0.2d, 04 §9.1) is not built and not ruled for build; ceremony_sessions.dart fails closed on it. 13 §4.3 disabled-with-reason and 07 §1 rule 6 (no dead ends): the reason names the way that works. Reason copy is a draft

deviations.what: Header reads 'Welcome back' with a person glyph — no name, no initials
deviations.reason: otp/verify does not carry the display name (SIGNIN1B contract); ⚠️ SPEC in the screen file
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05c §2 (the own display name *may* appear); open ⚠️ SPEC s0_2b_found_you_screen.dart

deviations.what: Body copy (bodyLarge subtitles and leads) draws with Material's inherited tracking at 16 px where the canvas sets 15.5 px untracked, so lines break a word or two earlier than the frame
deviations.reason: No token defines tracking and RkType.body sets none, so ThemeData merges the M3 default letterSpacing; the fix is one line in rkTextTheme for every screen (open item to the theme owner, as on S0.8). 15.5 px maps to the body role by rule
deviations.authority: app/lib/shared/theme.dart rkTextTheme — outside this lane's folders; ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (tokens.json decides values: type.body 16)
